# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b12 — Real room groups, not services

**Opt-in beta 12 for Home Assistant 2026.10+.** This corrects beta 11's registry/UI organization. The earlier release marked logical devices as services and used only parent-device links, which did not create the requested expandable room groups on the integration page.

## One group per room, with settings and physical-device controllers

Home Environment Manager is now classified as a **hub integration**. Each selected area has its own **room configuration subentry**, displayed as a room group. The group contains its ordinary general room settings device and one managed controller device per selected physical product. Multiple native endpoints belonging to one physical product remain grouped under that product's controller device, while independent control channels are preserved.

Home-wide settings remain on the Home device. Raw native devices stay with their original integrations and gateways. Nothing is presented as a service merely to make a logical room hub. The existing via-device links still record Home → Area → controller topology, while native subentry membership provides the integration-page grouping.

## Upgrade without deleting or recreating the integration

On startup the integration explicitly clears beta 11's stored service classification and migrates the existing device/entity registry entries into their room groups. **Device IDs, entity IDs, unique IDs, custom names, labels, disabled flags and user area overrides are preserved.** Every entity platform uses the same subentry as its device, preventing a reload from moving devices back to the flat parent list.

Selected equipment remains visible even when automatic control is not enabled. Inventory membership is not an actuation grant: automatic hardware control still requires the existing explicit commissioning, and the controller method defaults to Existing. All beta 11 climate interfaces, presets, PID and quiet-mode capabilities remain included.

## Room lifecycle and localization

Adding a room group adds monitoring membership only. Native area renames update an uncustomized group title; user-customized titles are kept. Removing a room group withdraws only that room's monitoring/inventory and control grants, retaining calibration and tuning data; existing controller recovery/retirement rules still apply. Other rooms and native physical devices are untouched.

Room-group setup and help are generated in all 38 supported languages, including Greek. Regression tests cover service-to-device migration, subentry membership, multiple physical products, disabled entities, reload identity, room additions/removal, and no implicit automation permission.

## Installation and verification boundaries

Back up your Home Assistant configuration. In HACS enable **Show beta versions**, select **v0.6.0b12**, and restart Home Assistant. Keep the existing integration entry—do not delete and re-add it. After startup, reopen Settings → Devices & services → Home Environment Manager and expand a room group.

Publication is gated by Python 3.13/3.14 regressions, deterministic translations, frontend validation, the pinned Home Assistant registry smoke check, Hassfest, HACS and archive verification. The attached manual installation ZIP includes a SHA-256 checksum. These checks do not operate or certify physical HVAC equipment. Stable **v0.5.1**, main and older beta tags are not changed.
